patch_list: Adds bestweb module settings page with tab blocking, supergroup toggle, and ad blocking info
Bypass Weibo WBSecurity and SLib native signature verification
Blocks ad items in comment sections (TAG_AT_AD, TAG_COMMENT_AD, TAG_LIKE_AD)
Blocks feed ad resort by returning early from ADResortFlowService
Blocks search result ads and video ads in the discover/search tab
Blocks splash/flash ads by finishing the ad activities immediately
Blocks supergroup from appearing in the home feed
